description.value: Ustaad G76 Abbotsford is part of a growing North Indian restaurant chain with 10+ locations across British Columbia, specializing in Amritsari Kulcha, sizzling tikkas, rich curries, and biryani. The Abbotsford outpost opened in 2024, bringing the brand's relaxed dining style — booth seating and playful wall art — to BC's Fraser Valley farming heartland. Online ordering is available through the brand's app and website.
